lever: Tea or coffee between meals rather than with them
intervention: Drinking tea, coffee or cocoa with a meal
summary: Tea, coffee, cocoa and many herbal teas contain polyphenols that strongly reduce how much iron is absorbed from a meal. Having them between meals avoids this.
whyThisGrade: Large, consistent effect in absorption studies (50–90% less iron absorbed from the meal)
Studies measured single meals; the effect on long-term iron stores is less certain

studies.title: Inhibition of non-haem iron absorption in man by polyphenolic-containing beverages
